shared_elements: tall upright slab/monolith carrying carved relief
frontal standing anthropomorphic figure occupying the whole field
head with elaborate headdress/head-covering at the top
circular disc or medallion ornament on the chest/belly
belt or horizontal banding across the lower body
panels of small repeated block-like signs in the upper zone
justification: Both depict a single frontal anthropomorphic figure filling a tall upright monument, with head and headgear at the top, arms folded over the torso, a round disc-like ornament at the chest and a belt-like band below, plus small blocky repeated signs in the upper field — a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in depicted content is the degree of figural articulation: A reduces the body to a few abstract curved bands and circles on a rounded boulder-like form with no discrete scene, while B presents a detailed, richly costumed figure in shallow relief within a bordered rectangular panel with distinct sign blocks above.
